hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: Each member is recovered by applying its operator to the latent function F: G0001 = Newton divided difference of F on nodes x,y = (F(x)-F(y))/(x-y); G0002 = first derivative of F at x = df(x).
required_assumptions: f is defined at x and y
f is differentiable at x for G0002
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: Both catalog expressions are generated from the same underlying function f by applying either a first-order divided difference on nodes x and y or a first derivative at x. The divided difference is the finite-difference precursor whose limit as y tends to x is the derivative.
